name: Open-Meteo Weather API
notes: Non-commercial use free without key; attribution required. Limits are [estimated] from public docs as of 2026-09-20.

name: OpenStreetMap Nominatim
notes: Strict one-request-per-second etiquette and a valid HTTP User-Agent are mandatory; bulk geocoding must use a local instance.

name: USGS Earthquake Hazards API
notes: Open government data; courtesy caching expected. Limit [estimated] as of 2026-09-20.

name: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
notes: JSON products for space weather; suitable for HF-radio/aviation risk context.

name: GDACS Global Disaster Alerts
notes: XML/RSS feeds for disaster events; level B because attribution and non-commercial framing are expected.

name: SEC EDGAR Full-Text & Filings API
notes: Requires declaring a contact User-Agent; no key but identity is mandatory. Level B for identity/etiquette rules.

name: arXiv API
notes: One request per three seconds is the documented courtesy guideline; metadata reuse is broad, full text follows each paper's license.

name: Wikipedia Action API
notes: Share-alike applies to text reuse; provide attribution and license links. Limit [estimated] as of 2026-09-20.

name: GitHub REST API (unauthenticated)
license: ToS-governed; repo content keeps its own license
notes: 60 req/h unauthenticated, 5000 with token; scraping instead of the API is prohibited by ToS.

name: NASA open APIs (EPIC/APOD etc.)
license: US Government public domain (imagery: attribution requested)
notes: Free DEMO_KEY exists but registering your own key is the intended path; hourly limits apply per key.

name: ADS-B Exchange (community)
license: community mirror terms vary; aircraft data is public-sourced
notes: Live aircraft positions are public broadcasts, but aircraft tracking aggregations raise stalking/privacy concerns: allowed for research queries, NOT for building public tracking products without legal review.

name: Hacker News Firebase API
license: ToS-light: public JSON, no explicit data license
notes: Widely used and public, but no explicit redistribution license: level C. Aggregatepublic use requires review.
